evidenceKind: primary DXF schema review, independent open-source field-map cross-check, and local parser/writer audit
question: Does NURBSURFACE DXF encode a repeated control-point/grid array whose component-order selectors need auditing?

sources.observation: The published SURFACE page defines common modeler payload groups 1/3 and U/V isoline counts 71/72. It does not define a repeated NURBS control-point grid or grid dimensions.
sources.limitation: The page lists common surface fields and is not a complete detailed table for every subtype-specific NURBSURFACE field.

sources.authority: Independent open-source field-map cross-check; not wire-format authority
sources.observation: The NURBSURFACE field listing maps fixed scalar fields 170/290 and four fixed 3D vectors at DXF groups 10-13; it does not list grid dimensions, knot arrays, or repeated control-point slots. Modeler/ACIS data is represented separately.
sources.limitation: Peer documentation can corroborate field inventory but cannot overrule Autodesk schema or qualify semantic preservation.

sources.authority: Official in-memory object API, not DXF serialization schema
sources.observation: The get/getControlPoints methods describe an in-memory array of AcGePoint3d control points and say the v index varies first.
sources.limitation: An in-memory API's array order does not establish any DXF group-code sequence; do not transfer it into the DXF parser absent wire-format evidence.

observedFields: Four fixed vectors uvec1/vvec1/uvec2/vvec2 encoded at point groups 10/11/12/13, each with X/Y/Z components
No repeated grid-point selector, grid dimensions, or NURBS knot/control-point arrays
localAudit.existingComponentHandling: Independent component masks track the X/Y/Z fields for each of the four fixed vectors.
localAudit.disposition: The hypothesized repeated NURBSURFACE grid-point permutation is not applicable to the mapped DXF wire fields. No production change or generated grid probe is warranted.
localAudit.semanticBoundary: This negative parser-order audit does not qualify NURBS surface geometry, ACIS/modeler payload semantics, rendering, or DWG behavior.

planDelta.nextStep: Proceed to the already-planned composed checkpoint: reconcile source/typed/raw/dropped-field dispositions under existing owners and run one pinned peer comparison. Keep native FreeCAD and independent ACIS/kernel qualification as separate external gates.
